parameters.content:
## Domain-Scoped Site Crawler for Markdown Datasets

**Actor:** [Domain-Scoped Site Crawler for Markdown Datasets](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/domain-scoped-site-crawler-for-markdown-datasets)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/domain-scoped-site-crawler-for-markdown-datasets.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `startUrls` (array, required)
- `maxCrawlDepth` (integer)
- `maxCrawlPages` (integer)
- `useSitemaps` (boolean)
- `useLlmsTxt` (boolean)
- `respectRobotsTxtFile` (boolean)
- `crawlOnlyPagesChangedSince` (string)
- `includeUrlGlobs` (array)
- `excludeUrlGlobs` (array)
- `includeUrlRegexps` (array)
- `excludeUrlRegexps` (array)
- `keepUrlFragments` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `url` (URL)
- `title` (Title)
- `depth` (Depth)
- `wordCount` (Words)
- `httpStatusCode` (Status)

description: Domain-Scoped site scraper: runs the Domain-Scoped Site Crawler for Markdown Datasets Apify Actor, returns url, title, depth, wordCount, httpStatusCode and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
